questions.prompt: Which AWS service is primarily used for DNS and domain management?
questions.explanation: Route 53 is AWS DNS and domain service.

questions.prompt: Which AWS service provides an easy way to create a virtual private cloud with subnets and security controls?
questions.explanation: VPC is AWS virtual networking.

questions.prompt: Which AWS service is best for storing frequently accessed objects with low latency globally via edge caching?
questions.explanation: CloudFront caches content at edge locations to reduce latency.

questions.prompt: Which service records AWS API calls for auditing?
questions.explanation: CloudTrail records API activity/events.
choiceExplanations: Correct. Audit trail of API calls.

questions.prompt: Which AWS service provides metrics, logs, dashboards, and alarms?
questions.explanation: CloudWatch is AWS monitoring/observability.

questions.prompt: Which service tracks resource configuration changes and can evaluate them for compliance?
questions.explanation: AWS Config tracks configuration and evaluates rules.

questions.prompt: Which AWS service provides a managed message queue for decoupling systems?
questions.explanation: SQS is a managed message queue.

questions.prompt: Which AWS service provides pub/sub notifications and fan-out to multiple subscribers?
questions.explanation: SNS is publish/subscribe messaging.

questions.prompt: Which AWS service provides managed NoSQL with single-digit millisecond latency?
questions.explanation: DynamoDB is managed NoSQL.

questions.prompt: Which AWS service is a managed relational database option?
questions.explanation: RDS is managed relational databases.

questions.prompt: Which AWS compute option is best described as 'run code without provisioning servers'?
questions.explanation: Lambda is serverless functions.

questions.prompt: Which AWS service provides container orchestration without managing Kubernetes (AWS-native orchestration)?
questions.explanation: ECS is AWS-native container orchestration.
choiceExplanations: Correct. ECS manages containers without Kubernetes.

questions.prompt: Which AWS service lets you run containers without managing servers for ECS/EKS?
questions.explanation: Fargate is serverless container compute.
choiceExplanations: Correct. No server management for containers.

questions.prompt: Which AWS service is primarily used to manage users, groups, roles, and policies?
questions.explanation: IAM is identity and access management.

questions.prompt: Which service provides DDoS protection for AWS applications?
questions.explanation: Shield provides DDoS protection.

questions.prompt: Which service is used to filter malicious web requests (SQLi/XSS) at L7?
questions.explanation: WAF filters web traffic using rules.

questions.prompt: Which service manages encryption keys integrated with AWS services for encryption-at-rest?
questions.explanation: KMS manages cryptographic keys.

questions.prompt: Which service provides dedicated hardware security modules (HSMs) you control?
questions.explanation: CloudHSM provides dedicated HSM appliances.
choiceExplanations: Incorrect. KMS is managed keys (not dedicated HSM per customer by default).

questions.prompt: Which is the BEST practice when granting permissions in AWS?
choices: Use broad wildcards to avoid access issues
Grant least privilege and review permissions regularly
Share a single IAM user across teams
Disable logging to reduce storage cost
questions.explanation: Least privilege reduces risk and blast radius.
choiceExplanations: Correct. Least privilege + review is best practice.
Incorrect. Logging is critical for auditing.

questions.prompt: Which service detects threats by analyzing logs like CloudTrail and VPC Flow Logs?
questions.explanation: GuardDuty is managed threat detection.

questions.prompt: Which service discovers and classifies sensitive S3 data such as PII?
questions.explanation: Macie scans S3 for sensitive data.

questions.prompt: Which AWS service provides best-practice recommendations for cost and security optimizations?
questions.explanation: Trusted Advisor provides best-practice checks and recommendations.

questions.prompt: Which service provides consolidated billing and governance for multiple AWS accounts?
questions.explanation: Organizations manages multiple accounts centrally.

questions.prompt: Which tool provides the most detailed cost and usage dataset for an AWS account?
questions.explanation: CUR provides detailed cost/usage line items.

questions.prompt: Which tool is commonly used to set alerts when forecasted monthly costs exceed a threshold?
questions.explanation: Budgets supports actual and forecast alerts.

questions.prompt: Which option best describes 'CapEx to OpEx' as a cloud benefit?
choices: Buying hardware upfront instead of paying monthly
Shifting from upfront capital purchases to pay-as-you-go operational spending
questions.explanation: Cloud shifts spending from upfront purchases to usage-based operating expense.
choiceExplanations: Correct. Cloud reduces upfront CapEx and increases OpEx flexibility.

questions.prompt: Which is typically the MOST cost-effective EC2 pricing for steady-state workloads with a 1-year commitment?
questions.explanation: Commitment-based discounts (Savings Plans/RIs) fit steady usage.
choiceExplanations: Incorrect. Flexible but usually more expensive for steady usage.
Incorrect. Spot is not guaranteed and can interrupt.
Incorrect. Dedicated Hosts are for compliance/licensing, not cost savings.

questions.prompt: Which EC2 pricing model uses unused AWS capacity and can be interrupted?
questions.explanation: Spot offers deep discounts with interruption risk.
choiceExplanations: Incorrect. On-Demand is not interruptible by pricing model.

questions.prompt: Which AWS service provides compliance reports and agreements (SOC reports, etc.)?
questions.explanation: Artifact is the compliance documentation portal.

questions.prompt: Which service provides object storage for backups, logs, and static assets?
questions.explanation: S3 is AWS object storage.

questions.prompt: Which S3 storage class is typically used for long-term archival with infrequent access and lower cost?
questions.explanation: Glacier classes are designed for archival use cases with different retrieval characteristics.
choiceExplanations: Incorrect. Standard-IA is infrequent access but not the deepest archive tier.
Incorrect. Intelligent-Tiering is for unknown access patterns, not strictly archival.

questions.prompt: Which AWS service is Infrastructure as Code using templates to provision resources?
questions.explanation: CloudFormation provisions resources from templates.

questions.prompt: Which service provides a managed API front door (auth, throttling, caching) for REST/HTTP APIs?
questions.explanation: API Gateway provides managed API capabilities.

questions.prompt: Which AWS service provides a global edge network for low-latency delivery of content?
questions.explanation: CloudFront uses edge locations globally.
choiceExplanations: Incorrect. VPC is networking in a Region.

questions.prompt: Which service provides event routing between AWS services and applications?
questions.explanation: EventBridge is an event bus and routing service.

questions.prompt: Which service provides managed workflows/orchestration across AWS services?
questions.explanation: Step Functions orchestrates workflows and state machines.

questions.prompt: Which service provides centralized SSO for workforce access to AWS accounts?
questions.explanation: IAM Identity Center provides SSO and centralized permission sets.

questions.prompt: Which statement about IAM policies is most accurate?
choices: Policies define who (principal) can do what actions on which resources, usually with conditions
Policies are only used for DNS settings
Policies are used only for billing forecasts
Policies are only applied to S3 and no other services
questions.explanation: IAM policies define permissions (actions/resources/conditions) for principals.
choiceExplanations: Correct. This is the core permission model.
Incorrect. Policies apply across AWS services.

questions.prompt: Which network control is stateful and attached to an ENI/instance?
questions.explanation: Security Groups are stateful instance/ENI firewalls.
choiceExplanations: Incorrect. NACL is stateless at subnet.

questions.prompt: Which AWS service provides secure storage and rotation for secrets like database credentials?
questions.explanation: Secrets Manager stores and rotates secrets.

questions.prompt: Which service provides a parameter store for configuration values used by applications?
questions.explanation: Parameter Store stores config and secrets parameters (with features by tier).

questions.prompt: Which AWS service provides offline data transfer appliances for migrating large datasets?
questions.explanation: Snowball is a physical appliance for data transfer.

questions.prompt: Which AWS service provides managed data warehousing?
questions.explanation: Redshift is data warehouse.

questions.prompt: Which AWS service provides a managed email service for sending transactional/marketing emails?
questions.explanation: SES is Simple Email Service.

questions.prompt: Which concept best describes distributing resources and designing for failure across AZs?
questions.explanation: High availability uses redundancy and fault isolation.
choiceExplanations: Correct. Redundancy across AZs improves availability.
Incorrect. SPOF is what you avoid.
Incorrect. Vertical scaling alone doesn't provide HA.

questions.prompt: Which cloud benefit allows you to quickly provision resources and experiment without long procurement cycles?
questions.explanation: Agility is rapid provisioning and iteration.
choiceExplanations: Incorrect. Cloud supports elasticity, not fixed capacity.

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes 'scalability'?
choices: The ability to increase capacity to meet demand
The ability to permanently prevent outages
The ability to store only relational data
questions.explanation: Scalability is increasing capacity to meet demand (vertically/horizontally).

questions.prompt: Which AWS service provides managed Kubernetes?
questions.explanation: EKS is managed Kubernetes control plane.
choiceExplanations: Incorrect. ECS is AWS native containers.

questions.prompt: Which is typically an advantage of AWS managed services?
choices: Reduced undifferentiated heavy lifting (patching, backups, scaling options)
questions.explanation: Managed services reduce operational overhead for common tasks.
choiceExplanations: Incorrect. AWS manages much of the underlying hardware.
Correct. Managed services reduce operational work.

questions.prompt: Which AWS feature provides 'pay only for what you use' most directly?
questions.explanation: Usage-based On-Demand pricing aligns cost to consumption.
choiceExplanations: Incorrect. Billing is automated by AWS.

questions.prompt: Which service helps you centrally manage patches, automation, and operational tasks across fleets (common AWS ops concept)?
questions.explanation: Systems Manager provides operational management tools (patching, run commands, inventory).

questions.prompt: Which AWS service can help you build a private connection to AWS that bypasses the public internet?
questions.explanation: Direct Connect provides private connectivity.

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes S3 versioning?
choices: It permanently deletes older versions automatically
It keeps multiple versions of an object to protect against overwrites/deletes
It encrypts all objects with a customer-managed key by default
It is used only for static website hosting
questions.explanation: Versioning helps protect against accidental overwrite/deletion by retaining versions.
choiceExplanations: Incorrect. Versioning retains versions; lifecycle rules can expire them.

questions.prompt: Which AWS tool provides a way to estimate AWS costs for planned usage (common CLF concept)?
questions.explanation: Pricing Calculator helps estimate costs for architectures.

questions.prompt: Which service helps you distribute traffic across multiple targets (high-level load balancing concept)?
questions.explanation: ELB distributes incoming application traffic across multiple targets.

questions.prompt: Which AWS service provides a way to automatically scale EC2 instance counts based on demand?
questions.explanation: Auto Scaling adjusts capacity to maintain performance and minimize cost.

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes 'fault tolerance'?
choices: The ability to continue operating despite component failures
The ability to run only one server
The ability to prevent all DDoS attacks automatically
questions.explanation: Fault tolerance means a system continues functioning during failures.
choiceExplanations: Incorrect. Single server is less fault tolerant.
Incorrect. DDoS protection helps but doesn't guarantee prevention.

questions.prompt: Which service provides managed object storage with lifecycle policies to transition data to cheaper tiers?
questions.explanation: S3 lifecycle policies can transition objects between storage classes.

questions.prompt: Which AWS service provides a managed file system for Linux workloads that can be mounted by multiple EC2 instances?
questions.explanation: EFS is shared file storage.

questions.prompt: Which AWS service provides a managed service to run virtual machines (instances)?
questions.explanation: EC2 provides virtual servers.
